title: Tauros Charges Trees Without an Opponent
premise: Show Tauros turning an empty battlefield into a tree-crashing outlet when no opponent appears.
audiencePromise: Reveal why Tauros attacks trees, then test that rage against evidence of calmer regional Tauros.
openLoop: What does Tauros do when nobody will fight it?
payoff: Tauros can replace a missing opponent with a thick tree, but Alolan Tauros complicate its angry image.
engagementQuestion: Is Tauros a tree-crasher, or secretly calmer?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a sharp surprise. Keep the pace quick, warm, and controlled. Stress tree-crasher, no opponent, and calmer.
